summary: DarkHorse Technologies Inc., formerly Sphere 3D Corp., filed an 8-K reporting the September 16, 2026 effectiveness of its continuance from Ontario to British Columbia, a new Notice of Articles and Articles under the BCBCA, and a legal name change. Shareholders approved the continuance and name change at an August 24, 2026 special meeting; the proxy statement was filed July 13, 2026, supplemented August 7, 2026. The ticker changes to DRK on Nasdaq. No price, stake, or transaction terms were stated; this is a routine corporate redomiciliation, not a special situation.
